screens.screen: home: map with current location and 'Hi there!' card
prepare ride: from/to fields, place search results, Review Ride FAB
review ride: route on map with trip summary sheet

notes: Flutter ride-booking demo titled 'Mapbox Cabs' in code (English, LTR, default Material 2 blue theme, system font - no custom fonts in the repo). Mapbox map is replaced by a neutral stylised map (no provider tiles/logo); route line is Colors.indigo width 3 as in code. The images the code references (assets/image/sport-car.png, assets/icon/circle.png, square.png) are not in the repo, so a simple car glyph and circle/square end markers were drawn. The fare '$384.22' and 'Premier' are hard-coded in the code. Place search is restricted to country=sd in code, so sample addresses are Khartoum streets; distance and drop-off time are sample values.
